Coloured Background = Permanent effect  ///  Black Background = Duration-based 
Identical Permanent effects and Duration-based effects can stack together. 
But two or more of the same Permanent effect/Duration-based effect will not stack. The higher % will override the lower %.
**Transcended Bonuses are also included. Please take note of the stars.**
